The decisive mistake was DataAnalysis_Expert's at step 8. After the placeholder download was found to be an HTML page, it ran curl with a literal `<URL>` and then a made-up API endpoint. It did not locate the real USGS NAS download link. The run failed because `<URL>` could not be resolved as a host, so the correct data was never obtained and the count of 6 was never reached.

AGENT: DataAnalysis_Expert
STEP: 8
